# Lab fixtures

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `quality-site/` | Static HTML for quality L0 |
| `themeunittestdata.wordpress.xml` | Cached [WordPress Theme Unit Test](https://github.com/WordPress/theme-test-data) WXR |
| `org-seed.json` | Written by `make org-seed` / theme-check seed (attachment/post/page IDs) |

Do **not** put Unit Test XML inside theme zips.
